metadata.title: Jelantara — Explore the Wonders of Indonesia
metadata.description: See crowd forecasts for Indonesian destinations, find the quietest time to visit, and help prevent overtourism. Data from BPS, BMKG, and destination operators.
metadata.keywords: tourist crowding|visitor forecast|overtourism|sustainable tourism|best time to visit|visitor quota|Indonesian destinations

footer.dataSource: Data sources: BPS, BMKG, and records from destination operators. Crowd forecasts are estimates.

planner.title: Plan a whole trip without opening a dozen tabs.
planner.body: Tell it where you want to go, how many days, and which city you are leaving from. The AI Planner gathers destinations, places to stay, and flights into a single itinerary you can book straight away. Every choice is still yours to swap before you pay.

planner.step2Body: See destinations, hotels, and flights with prices and ratings included.
planner.step3Body: Reserve flights and hotels together in one trip.
